What's the Vibe?
One number. Everyone knows it. Except you.
PartyGaming
🍎 Download on App Store▶ Google Play — Coming Soon
About
A pass-and-play party game for groups of 2 to 15. One player is the Guesser and everyone else sees a secret number between 1 and 10. The Guesser gives each person a category and tries to figure out the number from their answers. 300+ curated categories, two game modes, and a fully custom visual identity.
Highlights
300+ categoriesCurated prompts that actually get funny answers.
2-15 playersScales from a date night to a full house party.
Two modesPlayer Mode with rotating guessers, Team Mode with leaderboards.
Custom designFully designed dark-themed UI built from scratch.
